name: video_trailer
character: a trailer: hits land hard and often, the picture is cut to the music, and delivery is the streaming ceiling

video.hit_density.reason: a trailer cuts to the accents; the budget is raised rather than the rule dropped

video.cut_sync.reason: in a trailer the cue is the edit's clock, so the aim is tighter than a documentary cue's

video.cue_silence.reason: a trailer has no silent spotting: the picture is wall-to-wall by design
